strict_branch.description: Halt (not warn) if current branch != plan's Base branch

strict_scope.description: Halt if any dirty file lies within the plan's declared scope

unattended_revert_policy.description: Policy that controls how new pause paths behave under unattended execution. Required when stdin is not a TTY: cron/CI callers MUST pass an explicit value (pause | fail-fast | preserve-only). When stdin IS a TTY and the flag is absent, defaults to 'pause'. The resolved value is echoed back on the JSON envelope as unattended_revert_policy so the orchestrator can pin it as $UNATTENDED_REVERT_POLICY for the rest of the run.
